QuestInfo.name: [White Heaven] Step 4: Compensate!
QuestInfo.0: It's up to you to fix up the ship you wrecked. Go see Karula aboard her ship.
QuestInfo.1: Stick around with the condenser for 30 minutes to charge it up. Hey, whatever Karula wants...
QuestInfo.2: You turned over the charged condenser to Karula. It's a start.

0.0: Fine. If you're serious about helping, take this condenser. Hang onto it for about 30 minutes, and it'll soak up some of your power. I'll need that to get started on repairs.
0.1: This will collect power from you for me to use. Don't make a fuss, kid, you started all this.

yes.0: Hold on to this super sweet #b#i3996018#Power Condenser#k for #r30 minutes#k and it will turn into a #i3996019##rCharged Condenser#k! #bJust be sure you don't log out in the middle#k or it will disappear. These things are crazy fragile!

no.0: And don't try to get out of this. I've got no problem turning you into a frog.

default.0: Why are you standing around? Are you making sure the condenser is working?
